coverage.why: All seven accounting areas, the industry lens and every financial section carry a finding, but the gate dropped a sentence from areas.industry_lens and the anomaly industry_lens_customer_concentration (analysis_accounting.json dropped_items), which counts as unanswered.

calibration.why: Area verdicts track their anomalies in direction and weight (estimates_and_reserves 'Mixed' over two contradicts items; controls 'no adverse' over tagging items); the weak spots are cross_document_reconciliation, whose verdict says the release ties while its own anomaly says the quarter's investment gain cannot be tied, and industry_lens, whose verdict cites concentrated customers after that anomaly was gate-dropped.

valuation_reading.why: The calculator holds no price, no reverse DCF and no sensitivity grid (market.missing, implied_growth_beside_history.implied_ten_year_revenue_growth.missing, valuation.missing); the reading says so honestly but cannot place the price or state implied growth, and its two named drivers come from the spread of its own scenarios, not from a calculator sensitivity.
